title: Customer Service as a Marketing Function
summary: ORANGE-L2-036: Customer Service as a Marketing Function.
body: This ORANGE Level 2 lesson develops practical sales and marketing competency in Customer Service as a Marketing Function. Learners should connect the concept to customer behaviour, positioning, acquisition economics, conversion, retention and measurable business outcomes. The objective is to make evidence-based marketing and sales decisions, distinguish useful metrics from vanity metrics, and apply ethical persuasion without manipulation. Examples should be adapted to the relevant market, customer segment and regulatory environment.
